item.title: Who paid when Carillion collapsed? Staff, pensioners and taxpayers #Shorts
item.description:
Who paid when Carillion collapsed? Staff, pensioners and taxpayers #Shorts
Jobs, pensions and public money after Carillion's collapse, from National Audit Office and pension figures.
Full episode: "Carillion: How Britain's Biggest Builder Ran Out of Money" on Filed Under Failure. Sources: House of Commons Work and Pensions and BEIS Committees, Carillion report (16 May 2018); Committees' statement on Carillion's suppliers (14 May 2018); National Audit Office, Investigation into the government's handling of the collapse of Carillion (June 2018) (full list in the episode description). Narration uses a synthetic voice; graphics are our own.
#Shorts #Carillion #Carillioncollapse #businessdocumentary

item.description:
Silicon Valley Bank had 31 open supervisory findings when it failed #Shorts
What the Federal Reserve's supervisors found at Silicon Valley Bank, and what happened next.
Full episode: "Silicon Valley Bank: $40 Billion Gone in One Day" on Filed Under Failure: https://youtu.be/5fPvAEfxo6w Sources: Federal Reserve Board, Review of the Federal Reserve's Supervision and Regulation of Silicon Valley Bank (28 Apr 2023); Federal Reserve Board, Executive Summary of the review (28 Apr 2023); Federal Reserve Board press release on the review's results (28 Apr 2023) (full list in the episode description). Narration uses a synthetic voice; graphics are our own.
